creator: Alexander Terp
description: MUSTER_SOCKET names the window that made a pane: command-<pid>.sock on the laptop, window-<name>.sock on a devenv (forwarded over the ssh master). A pane outlives its window, so after Muster is relaunched every existing pane's muster says its window has quit, on both machines, and only panes the new window made reach it. A name kept per arrangement (or a stable per-install path the newest window takes over) would let old panes reach the reopened window. muster docs limits states the limit today.
title: A relaunched window leaves every pane's MUSTER_SOCKET pointing at the old window
